hook: 字尾 -uous：fatuous 傻笑、sinuous 蛇行、strenuous 喘、unctuous 油——派對貼紙全是「有點…的」。
script: fatuous／vacuous 空。sinuous 彎。strenuous 費力。tempestuous 暴。unctuous 油膩奉承。congruous 一致。DJ：尾巴決定氣場。

members.senseAnchor: curved or curving in and out
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 蛇行燈: sinuous walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「蛇行燈」出場：sinuous 一上場梗就黏住——蜿蜒的。
